title: Continuity — material cut
logline: For designers on X: one mark, three materials, every cut on the beat — made as code.

scenes.intent: Chrome: the mark whips round to face us and drifts — the first hit.
scenes.motion: rotateY −40° → −14° and rotateX 6° → −2° on the whip (85% in 1.5 frames), scale 0.9 → 1: it lands turned with its face tilted up a touch, so the studio's horizon line crosses the face; the camera dollies in 4%.

scenes.intent: Glass: the same mark bends the grid behind it.

elements.note: a card behind the glass with litt's hairline grid, for the bevels to bend

scenes.motion: The mark turns rotateY 48° → −14° and tilts up (rotateX 10° → −4°) on an out ease, fastest on the cut, so the deep bevels sweep the grid; the camera orbits a few degrees on an out ease.

scenes.intent: Neon: the mark as light, in the accent.

elements.note: neon tubes along the outline, bloom

scenes.motion: The mark whips in from rotateY 40° and rotateX −12° and the camera pushes in; bloom carries the light.

scenes.intent: The lockup: the neon mark cuts to the flat mark at the same size and place, holds a beat, then flies into the lockup; the wordmark types, the line wipes on the bar.

beats.note: the louder bar: the mark leaves the neon's place for the lockup
the wordmark types on the and
the line wipes on the next beat

scenes.motion: Match cut: the mark opens where the neon mark was (centre, ~576px) and holds a beat; on the 4.0s bar it travels into the lockup (out, snap: fastest on the beat). The wordmark types on, the line wipes on, and the card holds still. 3 bars total, so a loop seams on the bar line.
